title: Patterns
slide_intent: Teach designers to give pattern a specific editorial function. A repeat can emphasize a number, divide a section or point toward a conclusion.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can add energy to dense reports while keeping patterns distinctive by using them selectively.
demonstration: Three pattern samples introduce dots, diagonal stripes and chevrons. The applications beneath show them behind a statistic, on a divider and in a report layout.
practical_value: Pick the pattern according to the reader’s task, then check whether the information above it still has enough contrast and space.
